rv.q: San Diego Musical Theatre’s Rock of Ages is a big, loud, delightfully ridiculous blast of ’80s hair-band camp.
The casting is spot on, vibrant, very sexy, and super fun.
That money was wisely spent to create a lavish, big-cast and highly entertaining production that truly rocks.

cn.t: San Diego Musical Theatre delivers a delightfully campy, high-energy blast of '80s nostalgia with strong vocals, energetic choreography, and a live rock band that captures the era's excess perfectly.
